source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: the median of the annual total compensation of all our employees (excluding our CEO) was $178,015;

notes: Employees: full-time head count at January 31, 2026, from the FY2026 10-K; temporary employees and consultants are not included. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for fiscal 2026 is used (same year as the head count); the median employee was identified from about 10,586 individuals employed at December 31, 2025, using total cash compensation plus grant-date equity value.
